name: Lift.KummerChart.few_low_jumps
summary: Both parts reduce through mem_cupOrthogonal_of_scaledCupBounds to ScaledCupBounds for universal sides: (1) by scaledCupBounds_of_killsCokernel with κ = 0; (2) by exists_scaledCupBounds_few_low_jumps for the universal side of L, converting Z_p-lengths to O-lengths and counting embeddings per letter.

steps.claim: M: an x ∈ Z_f(L) with ScaledCupBounds(P, 0, c, x) for all pairings P of the universal sides of Y ∈ InClass(⊤, ⊥, U) and L lies in cupOrthogonal(InClass(⊤, ⊥, U), L) (mem_cupOrthogonal_of_scaledCupBounds, e = 0).
steps.lean: obtain M := k.mem_cupOrthogonal_of_scaledCupBounds ζ ho le_top le_rfl hL 0

steps.claim: The two parts; for (2), multiply both sides by [k_O : F_p] = length_{F_p}(k_O), k_O the residue field of O (positive and finite): by restriction of scalars, length_{Z_p}(M) = length_O(M)·[k_O : F_p] for an O-module M of finite length (length_restrictScalars), so it suffices that the Z_p-length of Z_f(L)/(Z_f(L) ∩ cupOrthogonal) is ≤ 11·f·(m(a + 1) + rank_O(L)(W + 1))·length_O(O/pO)·[k_O : F_p]:
steps.lean:
refine ⟨fun h₀ x m ↦ ?_, fun m hm ↦ (ENat.mul_le_mul_right_iff length_pos.ne' length_ne_top).1
    ((length_restrictScalars ℤ_[p] ..).ge.trans ?_)⟩

steps.claim: (1): for x ∈ Z_f(L), M applies by scaledCupBounds_of_killsCokernel (κ = 0) for the universal sides: the three cokernels are killed by E^a (killsCokernel_of_isUnramified, jumps ≤ (p − 3)a by ha), the windows by hV, the gaps by hs, and the alternative h₀.
steps.lean:
· simpa using M ⟨x, m⟩ fun _ _ Q
      _ ↦ by apply Q.scaledCupBounds_of_killsCokernel (κ := 0) _ hs hV <;> (try intro <;>
      and_intros <;> apply PairingSide.killsCokernel_of_isUnramified) <;> simp [*,
      hk.2] <;> clear * - h₀ ha hb hV <;> grind [letterJumps]

steps.claim: (2): rewrite the factor: length_O(O/pO)·[k_O : F_p] = length_{Z_p}(O/pO) (restriction of scalars again; the restriction-of-scalars factor of step 2) = dim_{F_p}(O/pO) (pZ_p acts by 0; O/pO is a vector space over F_p = Z_p/pZ_p) = rank_{Z_p}(O) (finrank_quotient_map); e.g. for the unramified quadratic O: length_O(O/pO) = 1 and dim_{F_p}(O/pO) = 2.
steps.lean:
rw [mul_assoc, ← length_restrictScalars, ← map_natCast (algebraMap ℤ_[p] O),
    ← Set.image_singleton, ← Ideal.map_span, ← PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p,
    length_eq_of_surjective residue_surjective (R := _ ⧸ _) (M := O ⧸ _),
    @length_eq_finrank _ _ (Ideal.Quotient.divisionRing _), finrank_quotient_map]

steps.claim: exists_scaledCupBounds_few_low_jumps for the universal side of L (hk, hp, ha, hb, hs, windows hV, n(i) from m, r(i) from rank_O(L) — the jump multiplicities at each embedding sum to the rank, exists_hasJumps —, hη): a submodule V of Z_f(L) with ScaledCupBounds on V, so V ⊆ the orthogonal (M) and the relative length is ≤ relLength(⊤, V) ≤ 11·Σ_i(n(i)(a + 1) + r(i)(W + 1)).
steps.lean:
refine ((k.universalSide ζ le_top hL).exists_scaledCupBounds_few_low_jumps hk hp ha hb hs
    (hV · |>.2) (by intro; grw [← mul_sum, sum_comm, hm]) (by intro; grw [← mul_sum, sum_comm,
    sum_le_sum fun g _ ↦ (hL.isPotCrys.exists_hasJumps g).rec fun J ⟨a, e⟩ ↦ funext e ▸ a ▸
    (sum_le_sum_of_ne_zero (by simp)).trans_eq J.toFinset_sum_count_eq]) hη).rec fun V H ↦
    ((relLength_mono le_rfl (T := ((cupOrthogonal ..).submoduleOf _).restrictScalars _) fun x y ↦ by
    simpa using! M x fun _ _ a _ ↦ H.2 _ a _ (hV · |>.1) _ y).trans (H.1.trans (mod_cast
    ?_))).trans_eq'
    (by rw [relLength_eq_length_map_mkQ, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_mkQ, length_top]; rfl)

steps.claim: The embeddings above distinct letters are distinct (the Teichmüller lifts differ by units, isUnit_teichmuller_sub), so the sum over letters is at most the sum over all embeddings, whose number is the degree of O over Z_p (card_algHom_eq_finrank).
